name: GetApp

sources.title: Third-party directory guide — GetApp is part of the Digital Markets network with Capterra and Software Advice; free listing via the vendor portal; listings may auto-populate from Capterra

conditions: Basic listing is free, but vendors must be accepted through the Digital Markets vendor portal (fit review, vendor verification) rather than instant self-publish
A product already listed on Capterra may auto-populate onto GetApp — claim the existing profile instead of creating a duplicate
requirements: B2B software aimed at small and mid-sized businesses (SaaS, cloud software, mobile business apps, industry-specific software)
Vendor account with company details, contact info, and product description; vendor verification may be required
Complete profile: categories, feature list, pricing info, screenshots
preparation: Check whether the product already appears on GetApp (auto-populated from Capterra) — claim rather than duplicate
Product description, screenshots, pricing details, feature list, correct category selection
Company and contact details for the vendor account
workflow: Search getapp.com for the product; if a profile exists, claim it
Otherwise create a vendor account via the 'Get listed' vendor flow (vendor portal shared across the Digital Markets network; getapp.com pages 403'd automated fetches)
Fill in the product profile: description, screenshots, pricing, categories, integrations
Submit for review; once live, maintain the listing and collect verified reviews to qualify for Category Leader badges
watchFor: getapp.com 403s automated fetches — use a browser
Paid PPC/pay-per-lead advertising upsells exist; the basic listing itself is free
Keep the description distinct-but-consistent with Capterra/Software Advice profiles — same network, editorial cross-checks
Ranking/Category Leader methodology rewards review recency and volume — a bare listing will sit low
countsAsLive: The product has a public profile page on getapp.com reachable from category search
unknowns: Current vendor intake URL (site is bot-blocked to automated fetches; network recently rebranded from Gartner Digital Markets)
Whether the profile link is dofollow or nofollow on the live page
